verdict.rationale: Grok Bot documents saving a multi-step path as a skill and rerunning it on a schedule, with an example of a weekday 8:00 AM routine and event-triggered routines. One-off tasks run on a persistent cloud computer while the laptop is closed, and results can be reviewed from mobile. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of scheduling a one-off task for a future time, documented result-delivery notifications for completed scheduled runs, and independent hands-on corroboration of schedules beyond a passing community mention of routines.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can schedule recurring or one-off tasks that run automatically and come back to me with results

citations.quote: Walk a Bot through a multi-step path once, and it can save the path as a skill and rerun it on a schedule.
Every weekday at 8:00 AM, run the Daily customer-risk skill against the current account list.
Cursor account integrations can start a routine from an event, such as a Slack message or a GitHub notification.
work continues while your laptop is closed
Use Grok Bot on iPhone or Android to start work, answer questions, approve steps, and review results away from your desk.
